import os
from eth_account.account import Account
from eth_account.signers.local import LocalAccount
from flashbots import flashbot
from web3 import Web3, HTTPProvider

w3 = Web3(HTTPProvider('https://rpc.flashbots.net'))

code_examples.python_full_bundle_example:
import os
from eth_account.account import Account
from eth_account.signers.local import LocalAccount
from flashbots import flashbot
from web3 import Web3, HTTPProvider

PROVIDER_URL = os.environ.get('PROVIDER_URL', 'https://rpc.flashbots.net')
w3 = Web3(HTTPProvider(PROVIDER_URL))

sender: LocalAccount = Account.from_key(os.environ.get('ETH_SENDER_KEY'))
signer: LocalAccount = Account.from_key(os.environ.get('ETH_SIGNER_KEY'))

flashbot(w3, signer)

TARGET_BLOCK = w3.eth.block_number + 1
current_block = w3.eth.get_block(TARGET_BLOCK - 1)
min_timestamp = current_block.timestamp
max_timestamp = min_timestamp + 120

bundle = [
  {
    'signer': sender,
    'transaction': {
      'to': '0xRECIPIENT_ADDRESS',
      'value': w3.to_wei(0.001, 'ether'),
      'gas': 21000,
      'maxFeePerGas': w3.to_wei(100, 'gwei'),
      'maxPriorityFeePerGas': w3.to_wei(2, 'gwei'),
      'nonce': w3.eth.get_transaction_count(sender.address),
      'chainId': 1,
      'type': 2
    }
  }
]

result = w3.flashbots.send_bundle(
  bundle,
  target_block_number=TARGET_BLOCK,
  opts={'minTimestamp': min_timestamp, 'maxTimestamp': max_timestamp}
)
print('Bundle hash:', result.bundle_hash())
